policy.title: Policy & services
policy.intro: How HARUTO Express calculates weight, handles compensation, and runs its buy-for-you, bid-for-you, and ship-for-you services.

standard.title: Standard goods
standard.body: Charged by the actual weighed kilograms.

bulky.title: Bulky goods
bulky.body: Counted as bulky when length + width + height exceeds 140 cm or the weight is over 30 kg (e.g. bicycles, suitcases, speakers, wedding-dress or suit boxes). Volumetric weight = (Length × Width × Height) ÷ 6,000 (cm). The freight uses the greater of actual and volumetric weight.

rounding.title: Rounding rules
rounding.body: Under 1 kg rounds up to 1 kg. Over 1 kg rounds to one decimal place (e.g. 3.04 kg → 3 kg; 3.05 kg → 3.1 kg).

diagram.label: How a parcel is measured for volumetric weight

insured.title: With cargo insurance
insured.body: 100% of the declared value is compensated. Insurance fee: 8% of the declared value.

uninsured.title: Without cargo insurance
uninsured.body: 100% of the shipping value is compensated, capped at 3,000,000 VND per order.

items.question: What goods does HARUTO accept?
items.answer: The goods we can carry depend on each country's regulations. Our staff check the goods and documents before confirming acceptance.

items.question: How are shipping rates calculated?
items.answer: Rates use the greater of actual and volumetric weight (Length × Width × Height ÷ 6,000). Vietnam → Japan is priced by weight band, with separate tables for clean and mixed goods; Japan → Vietnam is 155,000 VND/kg. See the Pricing section for the full tables and surcharges.

items.question: Can I track my shipment online?
items.answer: Online tracking is being planned. For now, please contact our support staff to ask about your parcel's status.

items.question: Do I need a Visa or MasterCard to buy from Japan?
items.answer: No. Just send the product link: HARUTO quotes at the VCB + 5 rate (no surcharge) and pays the Japanese shop for you. For buying orders you pay 100% of the item price.

items.question: How much deposit does auction bidding need?
items.answer: A 50% deposit before bidding. If you win, you pay the rest and HARUTO settles the purchase; if you don't, HARUTO refunds 100% of the deposit.

items.question: Which websites can HARUTO buy from?
items.answer: Yahoo! Auction, Mercari, Rakuten, Amazon Japan and other Japanese online stores. Send the product link and HARUTO will check it and quote.

items.question: Can I buy myself and send the goods to HARUTO's Japan warehouse?
items.answer: Yes. With our shipping-only service you buy the goods yourself and send them to HARUTO's Japan warehouse address; HARUTO consolidates them free of charge and ships them to Vietnam.

items.question: What does HARUTO's fulfillment service include?
items.answer: Receiving and storage in Japan, inventory management, picking and packing to your requirements, delivery across Japan and regular order reports. HARUTO also handles Japan ⇄ Vietnam shipping.

items.question: Which businesses is fulfillment in Japan for?
items.answer: Vietnamese exporters to Japan, retailers selling on Japanese marketplaces, cross-border e-commerce businesses needing a transit warehouse, and Vietnamese brands growing in Japan.
